description: This file defines internal classes and templates for managing memory layout of arrays with dynamic sizes, including alignment, offset calculations, and pointer utilities, as part of the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::Aligned
classes.description: Template struct to specify custom alignment for array types within the layout.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::internal_layout::LayoutImpl
classes.description: Internal class template implementing memory layout logic, offset calculations, and pointer utilities for arrays.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::Layout
classes.description: Public class template providing user-facing API for defining memory layouts of multiple arrays with specified sizes.

methods.name: Layout::Partial
methods.description: Static method to create a partial layout with specified sizes for some arrays.

methods.name: Layout::AllocSize
methods.description: Method to compute total size needed for the memory layout.

methods.name: Layout::Pointer
methods.description: Template method to get a typed pointer to a specific array within the layout.

methods.name: Layout::Pointers
methods.description: Method to get a tuple of pointers to all arrays.

methods.name: Layout::Slice
methods.description: Method to get a span representing a specific array.

methods.name: Layout::DebugString
methods.description: Method to generate a human-readable string describing the memory layout.
